summary.en: A digital Werewolf (Mafia) party game — hand-illustrated role cards dealt to each phone, one table on the big screen.
summary.jp: デジタル版の人狼ゲーム。手描きの役職カードが各自のスマホに配られ、大画面に卓が映る。

mine: Designed a digital Werewolf (Mafia) party game for one shared table screen
